value.description:
The CSS color specification. Pure red can be specified in all these ways:
 - `#ff0000`
 - `#ff0000ff`
 - `#f00`
 - `#f00f`
 - `rgb(255, 0, 0)`
 - `rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)`
 - `hsl(0, 100%, 50%)`
 - `hsla(0, 100%, 50%, 1)`
 - `red`

@see https://www.w3.org/TR/2018/REC-css-color-3-20180619/

title:
Colors are fundamentally a subset of the CSS color specification. We support the hex format and the `rgb`, `rgba`,
`hsl` and `hsla` (decimal) formats as well as the basic color keywords (such as "black" and "white") and
"transparent".

@see https://www.w3.org/TR/2018/REC-css-color-3-20180619/
name: Color
